# Steam — longstanding kidnapping progression reports

- Original source: [Bug - Secuestro de Robin Hood](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/3008934419482734392/)
- Author / publication: Bancrofth and respondents; Steam Community.
- Language / date: Spanish with English and Russian replies; opened 2021-01-11, last reply 2024-10-25.
- Access: Opening post and all 16 comments retrieved directly across both pages
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete post-by-post notes (Steam discussion, not transcribed)

Bancrofth reports that the rescue mission never appears despite completing side missions and restarting the campaign. Sebast describes being stuck at 63%. Xiño reports getting past the transition in the GOG edition by playing the preceding black-guard mission in English, then returning to Spanish for the rescue.

Janissary reports a similar French-version problem, while xd4n1x reports no such issue in Italian. These anecdotes do not establish which builds are affected. Other replies describe missing saves after language changes and difficulty locating Steam’s language selector. No save-recovery method or technical diagnosis is established.

Facts usable for parity work: the blocked transition is between the "black guards" mission and the Robin rescue mission; the failure is reported for Spanish and French, not Italian or English; the Steam language selector is the property-page dropdown; switching Steam language makes existing saves invisible, and switching back did not restore them for two posters. Nobody in the thread identifies the mechanism.
